name: Crowned in Vermilion
source:
Your name is Simhananda. You are here to kill the king.

Traverse the dark, familiar pathways through the royal palace, hounded by spectres from your past that seek to sway you from your mission. A short visual novel with storybook-like illustrations. There is only one choice that matters.

[From [url=https://halcyyyon.itch.io/crowned-in-vermilion]itch.io[/url]]
